entries.title: Skim can walk you through the figures
entries.body: Skim has a new Figures choice: a walk through the article's figures, data tables and media, in the order they appear. Step forward and back, or pick one from a list; each is shown in the article itself, with the author's caption where there is one. Figures works even while Skim's route is still being prepared. In Structure, a small icon after a section's title shows that it contains figures, tables or media, with a number when there is more than one.

entries.title: Referee gathers your notes into a review
entries.body: Referee has a new Notes view: every comment you have written on the article, in reading order, each with the passage it is on. Sort each note as Major or Minor, and Copy notes puts them on your clipboard as plain text, grouped under Major, Minor and not yet sorted. Only your own words go out; the AI writes and suggests nothing. Referee is behind the Experimental features switch on your profile page.

entries.title: Guide chat comes first in the command bar
entries.body: Open the command bar with nothing typed and Guide chat is the top row: a conversation about how to read this piece, why you are reading it, where to start, and which modes would help. Typing "help me read" or "chat with the guide" also finds it, and a compass icon marks it.

entries.title: Sources sits to the left of Referee
entries.body: In the bar of modes at the bottom of the screen, and in the command bar's list, Sources comes before Referee. Phones and tablets follow the same order.

entries.title: The Feedback window is larger on big screens
entries.body: On windows 1280 pixels wide or more, the Feedback window is wider, and on tall screens taller too, so there is more room to write.
